Suct Stainless Steel Flask Mug, Capacity: 400ml

The Suct Stainless Steel Flask Mug, Capacity: 400ml is a perfect blend of modern design, functionality, and durability. Designed for professionals, travelers, and daily coffee or tea lovers, this premium flask mug comes with a slightly visible orange suction base that is specifically engineered to prevent accidental tipping. Whether you are working at your desk, commuting, or relaxing at home, this suction mug ensures a stable and spill-free experience.

Crafted from high-quality stainless steel, the Suct Stainless Steel Capacity: 400ml offers excellent temperature retention, keeping your beverages hot or cold for longer durations. The smart suction technology at the base firmly grips smooth surfaces, reducing the risk of spills caused by accidental knocks. Available in stylish Black and Gray colors, this complements both professional and casual environments.

Innovative Suction Base for Spill Protection

One of the standout features of the Suct Stainless Steel Capacity: 400ml is its advanced suction base. The slightly visible orange suction base activates when placed on flat surfaces, holding the mug securely in place. This innovative design helps prevent accidental tipping, making it ideal for office desks, study tables, bedside tables, and car dashboards.

Unlike traditional travel mugs, this suction lifts easily when pulled vertically, ensuring convenience without compromising safety. It is a smart solution for busy professionals, students, and anyone who values mess-free hydration.

Premium Stainless Steel Construction

Built with food-grade stainless steel, the Suct Stainless Steel Capacity: 400ml is rust-resistant, odor-free, and easy to clean. The insulated body helps maintain beverage temperature while the smooth exterior provides a comfortable grip. This makes it suitable for coffee, tea, green tea, herbal drinks, or even cold beverages.

The 400ml capacity is ideal for everyday use, offering just the right amount for a refreshing break without the need for frequent refills. Its compact size fits easily into backpacks, office bags, and cup holders.

Available Colors & Elegant Design

The Suct Stainless Steel Capacity: 400ml is available in two elegant and versatile colors:

  • Black – A classic, professional look suitable for offices and corporate gifting
  • Gray – A modern, minimal shade perfect for daily use

The sleek design combined with a subtle orange suction base adds a contemporary touch while maintaining functionality. It is an excellent choice for corporate gifts, promotional giveaways, and personal use.

Key Features

  • Capacity: 400ml stainless steel flask mug
  • Slightly visible orange suction base for enhanced stability
  • Designed to prevent accidental tipping
  • Durable and food-grade stainless steel body
  • Suitable for hot and cold beverages
  • Available in Black and Gray colors
  • Ideal for office, home, travel, and gifting
  • Easy to clean and maintain

Why Choose?

The Capacity: 400ml stands out due to its combination of smart design and premium materials. The anti-spill suction base enhances safety, while the insulated stainless steel body ensures superior performance. It is a practical solution for anyone looking for a reliable, stylish, and spill-resistant travel mug.

Whether you are upgrading your daily drinkware, searching for a thoughtful gift, or looking for a premium promotional product, this suction stainless steel delivers quality, convenience, and modern aesthetics.
